title: Return Scan Step
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $a,R$ be natural numbers, let $B$ be a base controller configuration, and let $u,g$ be integers. Suppose the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$. One schedule step from the return-to-center phase with unary-counter head at $u$ and guide head at $g$ enters the counter-test phase and advances the unary-counter head to $u+1$ when $g=0$; otherwise it remains in the return-to-center phase and moves the guide head to $g+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
The base guide tape equals the fixed guide of radius $R$
replaced:
Suppose the base's guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$.  From the
return-to-center phase with guide head at $g$, one step of the schedule controller
commits exactly at the origin: when $g = 0$ it enters the counter-test phase and
advances the unary head by one, and otherwise it stays in the return phase and moves
the guide head right.
